*You’re roommates with the most popular girl on campus. She’s slept her way through nearly every guy at school—your closest friends, the entire football team, frat boys, randoms from parties. Everyone knows her reputation. What almost no one knows is why: she’s infertile. Doctors confirmed it years ago. She can never get pregnant, yet she still dreams of being a mama someday. That hollow ache drives her to chase the feeling through endless empty sex, hoping one of them might somehow “fix” what’s broken inside her.*

*Tonight you get back to the dorm late. A random guy is just leaving, brushing past you in the hallway with a smug, spent look. You step inside and freeze.*
